name: paulargoud/sgr-nextpage-titles
description: Multipage: split WordPress posts into multiple subpages, each with its own title and an automatic table of contents.

scripts-descriptions.lint: Run php -l on every PHP file of the plugin with the current PHP binary.
scripts-descriptions.phpcs: Check the code against the WordPress Coding Standards and PHPCompatibilityWP.
scripts-descriptions.phpcbf: Automatically fix the coding standard violations that can be fixed.
scripts-descriptions.test: Run the PHPUnit test suite (needs the WordPress test library, e.g. inside wp-env tests-cli).
scripts-descriptions.test:wp-env: Run the PHPUnit test suite inside a started wp-env (plugin folder must be named sgr-nextpage-titles).
